title: Clinic Appointment Booking System
description: End-to-end dental clinic booking system: patients book via form, get confirmation + 24h/1h email reminders, can self-cancel through a secure link, and the clinic owner gets a live HTML dashboard of today's, upcoming, and cancelled bookings.
case_study: Built for a dental clinic drowning in manual scheduling calls. The flow chains 4 workflows: booking capture, a two-step cancel-confirmation to avoid accidental cancels, and a real-time dashboard. Cut no-shows with automated reminders and gave the owner a single glance view of their day.

title: RAG Chatbot Demo
description: Retrieval-augmented chatbot: FAQ text is chunked and embedded via Gemini into a Supabase vector store, then a chat interface answers questions using the closest retrieved chunks, powered by Groq.
case_study: A portfolio demo showing a full RAG pipeline — not just a wrapper around an LLM. Ingest workflow handles chunking + embedding; the chatbot workflow does similarity search and grounds answers in retrieved context instead of hallucinating from the model alone.

title: AI B2B Lead Intelligence & CRM Pipeline
description: Sample leads flow through deduplication, ICP rule filtering, enrichment, and Groq AI scoring with written reasoning. High-score leads need human approval via Telegram before being saved to a Google Sheets CRM, with a daily summary report.
case_study: Designed to keep a human in the loop for high-value leads instead of full automation blind spots. AI does the heavy lifting — scoring and reasoning — but nothing enters the CRM without a Telegram approval tap, balancing speed with control.

title: Lead Qualification & Auto-Response
description: Webhook-triggered lead qualification: receives Tally form submissions, scores leads Hot/Warm/Cold via AI, logs every lead to a Google Sheets CRM, and routes accordingly — Hot leads get a drafted reply + Telegram alert, Warm leads get an automatic follow-up.
case_study: Built to remove response-time lag on inbound leads. Every submission gets scored and logged automatically; only the highest-value leads interrupt a human, so nothing sits unread while still keeping fast replies on the leads that matter most.

title: Email Assistant
description: Full email-assistant lifecycle in one workflow: Gmail-triggered classification and drafting, Telegram-triggered approval handling (Send/Edit/Reject), and hourly reminder checks — all sharing a pending-replies data table.
case_study: Solves inbox overload without losing control of tone or accuracy. AI drafts replies automatically, but every send goes through a Telegram approve/edit/reject step, with hourly nudges so nothing drafted gets forgotten.

title: Daily News Digest
description: Fetches BBC + Al Jazeera world news daily at 8am (Asia/Dhaka), uses Groq AI to pick and summarize the top stories, then sends the digest straight to Telegram.
case_study: A small personal-productivity automation — replaces manually scanning multiple news sites each morning with one AI-curated summary delivered on a schedule, no app-switching required.

title: FB Auto Post with Telegram Approval
description: Telegram-triggered Facebook page auto-poster: send a topic, Gemini writes the post copy and Pollinations generates the image, approve or decline right in Telegram, and approved posts go live on the FB Page.
case_study: Built for lightweight social content production without a full design/copy pipeline. One Telegram message becomes a fully drafted post with matching AI-generated art — human approval stays the final gate before anything goes public.
